scenario_definitions.noise: Gaussian noise added independently to each sensor channel; magnitude is a fraction of that channel's dataset standard deviation
scenario_definitions.missing: Random sensor-channel rows set missing independently per device; models forward-fill predictors only and omit missing targets
scenario_definitions.drift: Linear drift added to purified TDS from zero to magnitude times the device's base purified-TDS standard deviation

interpretation: Sensitivity results are simulator stress tests only; no external or field validation is implied.
